senses.gloss: pr. n. pl. (Gr. Ἔμεσα, Ἔμισσα) Ḥămâts, Emesa (mod. Hums) a city of Syria on the Eastern bank of the Orontes.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 37:6">Gen. R. s. 37</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:2">Y. Meg. I, 71ᵇ</cite> bot. (expl. <cite ref="R00596"><he>צמרי</he></cite>, <cite ref="Genesis 10:18">Gen. X, 18</cite>).—

Y. Kil. IX, 32ᶜ bot.; Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵇ bot. ימא דח׳ the Lake of E. (an artificial bay made under Diocletian); Midr. Till. to Ps. XXIV ימא דחמין (corr. acc.).—Denom. חֲמָצָאֵי, חוֹמְצָאֵי m. pl. inhabitants of Emesa.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 10:18">Targ. Y. Gen. X, 18</cite>; <cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 1:16">Targ. I Chr. I, 16</cite>.
